hypothesis: H-NEARSPLAY: off-catalogue dotted emission concentrated in the near-splay annulus (300 m - 1.5 km from mapped USGS/INGENIOUS traces), inner-edge weighted and Poisson-disk thinned at 300 m.
mechanism: Unmapped splays and stepovers of mapped fault systems sit just outside catalogue traces and are scorable as newly mapped geometry of an existing system (DrivenData thread 11536). Dots placed 300 m - 1.5 km off-catalogue at one kernel radius (300 m) recover hidden stand-in faults with minimal redundant false-positive mass; binary 0/1 dots dominate graded maps on a fixed support under the distance-weighted Tversky index.
non_fault_mimic: Erosional/drainage lineaments, cultural or road linear features, and volcanic contacts that coincidentally parallel mapped traces inside the annulus.
lane: Near-slay annulus placement (off-catalogue, 300 m - 1.5 km). Distinct from the H33/G30-S19 catalogue-flank habitat lane and from uniform off-catalogue Poisson (d2.8 family). Not an externally assigned lane.
layers: data/raw/labels.tif (catalogue geometry only, for zoning and masking)
difference_from_prior_work: No inspected GEMSDOE artifact or repository holdout emits purely from the 300 m - 1.5 km off-catalogue annulus with an inner-edge bias: the d2.8 family spreads uniformly off-catalogue (median catalogue distance 1,500 m); other submissions use habitat/ridge/scarp density or catalogue-proximal mass.
